concept.hr: Kopija javlja uredno; tek proba oporavka pokaže što u njoj nema
concept.en: Backups report OK; only a test restore shows what is missing

summary.hr: Pusti posao da radi noćima ili tjednima uz jednu provjeru na nadzoru, pa vrati: postoji, ispisuje se, status 0, a datoteke nema.
summary.en: Let the job run for nights or weeks with one check on the dashboard, then restore: it exists, it lists, status 0, and the file is not there.

concept.hr: Dnevnik osam tjedana kaže „nightly OK”; jedan tjedan ima 1,2 MB
concept.en: Eight weeks of "nightly OK" in the log; one week is 1.2 MB
